question: Should the current collapsible agent-section and footer-chip design receive a focused visual-hierarchy polish, or should agent selection move to a separate persistent dropdown above the session list?
rationale: Both designs are technically feasible, but choosing the permanent agent/session navigation hierarchy is a product and UX decision that cannot be resolved from this screenshot-free report alone.

options.title: Polish current hierarchy
options.body: Keep collapsible agent sections and the footer switcher, but strengthen labels, nesting, contrast, spacing, and selection affordances after obtaining a screenshot of the confusing state.

options.title: Add persistent dropdown
options.body: Place a dedicated agent selector above the session list and show only that agent’s sessions, accepting a larger navigation-model change.

options.title: Keep current design
options.body: Close without UI changes if maintainers consider the existing agent headers and footer chip sufficiently clear.

recommendation.title: Polish current hierarchy
recommendation.body: Keep collapsible agent sections and the footer switcher, but strengthen labels, nesting, contrast, spacing, and selection affordances after obtaining a screenshot of the confusing state.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history connects this person to the session-picker merge and the adjacent chat session-controls ownership boundary.
